item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Ready for today? It's Friday, October 30. Time for the weather! Friday at last. One more day and it's the weekend. Here in Shanghai, the day will be quite foggy. The high will be 22 degrees, and the low will be 14 degrees. Nice and comfortable today, not too hot and not too cold. There is a 50 percent chance of rain. There are 1 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Pack your umbrella and your wellies! As for tomorrow, expect it to be misty and grey, with a high of 23 degrees. One more day of thinking about trying something hard. What stands out? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
